visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts in an animation style with a young girl sitting on a wooden step indoors, putting on blue sneakers. She has short red hair, wears a white tank top, and yellow shorts. A blue cat-like creature with many legs, known as Capoo, peeks out from a doorway in the background. The background is a clean, simple indoor home entrance with a light brown floor and a pink handbag sitting on the step next to the girl. (2) Capoo finds a cardboard box and dives into it, scattering several small yellow boots on the white floor. The box has a paw print logo on it. Capoo's many legs are visible as it wiggles inside the box. (3) Capoo sits on the floor, looking confused and slightly annoyed, holding one yellow boot. It attempts to put the boots on its many small legs, struggling and sweating. (4) Capoo successfully puts on all the yellow boots and sparkles with joy. It now has a small green bag on its back. (5) Capoo stands outside a yellow door on a white porch, looking left and right expectantly. It sees the girl's shadow walking away in the distance. The background is a simple house exterior with two round windows. (6) Capoo realizes it has been left behind and begins to cry dramatically, with large tears streaming down its face. Speed lines appear in the background to emphasize the emotional distress. (7) It is now nighttime, with a purple-to-blue gradient sky filled with stars. The girl is shown walking towards a small house with a red roof on a green hill. She opens the door and looks inside with a smile. (8) Inside, Capoo is curled up on the floor, appearing sad or pouting, with the green bag nearby. The girl reaches out and pets its head. (9) The girl holds a fried chicken drumstick to comfort Capoo. Capoo's eyes well up with tears again, and it suddenly shoots out powerful jets of tears from its eyes like water cannons, knocking the girl back and soaking the room. (10) In the final scene, the girl helps Capoo into a single, giant red sneaker that fits its entire body like a vehicle. They both look happy and give a thumbs-up. A yellow mat with the text 'BUGCAT CAPOO' is visible in the foreground.
